title: Priests and bishops of Ireland
html_source:
EdwardVII’s first visit to Ireland as king in 1903 coincided with the death of Pope Leo XIII, whom Edward had met some years earlier. Protesters, such as Maud Gonne, draped black petticoats from their houses in unlikely mourning for the pope, but Edward’s condolences smoothed his visit to Maynooth College where he was greeted by three archbishops and 20 bishops.
